title: Sign-in page: a language picked before signing in is not saved as the person's own preference when they have none (save after #30157)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Follow-up card the `domain:ui#3` seat owes from #30338 (ruling D, claim 6653153124). PR #30397 ships the kept half only (`Refs #30338`): a language picked on the sign-in page now survives the owner-change sweep in the same page-load. This card is the saved half.

## Observed

- #30338 Wanted: a pick made on the sign-in page is "saved as their own preference if they have none". After #30397 the pick is kept in the `objectui-locale` slot but never written to `sys_user.locale`.
- The save needs the signed-in adapter write `adapter.update('sys_user', id, {locale})` (the globe's door, `useUserLocale.ts`). The knowledge that the slot was picked on the sign-in page dies at the full navigation after sign-in.
- "Column null + slot set" on the next page-load is not a usable signal: the profile card's "use deployment default" writes `locale: null` and leaves the slot set, so saving the slot there would undo that choice on every boot.
- Measurement: `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat3/measure-30338.md` (project file) and os-dev-report 6654595947.

## Ruled route (seat ruling D, 11-05)

Route **B**: in the sign-in page-load, when the person signs in with a pick made on that page and their `sys_user.locale` is unset, await the `sys_user` write before `window.location.assign`. ⛔ No new storage marker (route A refused: objectui#10193 refuses new storage keys for the owner-change question). ⛔ No fire-and-forget beside the navigation (route C races the unload).

## Serial

The write lives in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/**` (LoginPage), held by #30157 (`domain:ui#4`, PR #30243). Start after #30157 lands.

Blocked-by: #30157
Refs: #30338
